title: The Squishy Bearz Rainbow Enchanted Fun Minute
description: They’re the Squishy Bearz and they’re right over there. They’re the squishiest bears you know! Join Kozy, Puffy, Wuz Wuz, and Pierre for enchanted fun.
altHero: the four Squishy Bearz in a mouth, next to a giant uvula

alt2: Pierre with his foot stuck in a giant bear trap
alt3: the Bearz on a four-seat tandem bicycle
alt4: Kozy speaking to the other Bearz who are playing cards
